jobs.description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Optimize. Innovate. Deliver. Join us in redefining manufacturing excellence. As a (Senior) Supervisor Maintenance Automation on our Manufacturing and Operations team, find yourself in a high-tech world where silicon wafers evolve into cutting-edge products. In our advanced cleanroom environment, every detail counts, and your expertise will help shape the future, one innovation at a time.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Disciplinary and functional leadership of the shift team, including the development and coaching of employees and apprentices- Responsibility for transport systems and automation equipment in the 200 mm and 300 mm manufacturing facilities- Execution of IT FAB support for both production lines, including AMC shutdowns as well as coordination and escalation to on-call support teams- Responsibility for the timely response to disruptions, including the initiation of appropriate corrective actions (crisis management)- Ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety regulations, security requirements, fire protection regulations and cleanroom guidelinesThe position involves working in a continuous 8-hour shift system in a cleanroom environment. You will work six consecutive days followed by four days off, rotating through two morning shifts, two late shifts, and two night shifts.Your profileYou are able to effectively communicate the company’s strategic direction and create and foster a trust-based work environment that encourages learning from mistakes. In addition, you promote an open culture of communication within your area of responsibility, where questions and information can be shared freely and are viewed as opportunities for continuous improvement.Qualifications and skills to help you succeed- Completed vocational training in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Technology, or a comparable field- At least three years of professional experience in maintenance, ideally within the semiconductor industry- Strong knowledge of automation systems and control room operations- Ability to maintain an overview and make sound decisions in complex situations- Excellent communication skills to ensure close collaboration between office-based and production-line teams- Confident communication skills in both German and English are mandatory#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.Sophie Leuschner

Boeing Global Services, Consumables & Expendables (C&E) Distribution Business is looking for an EHS Specialist (f/m/d) for the Henstedt-Ulzburg, GER facility.Position Summary:The Environment Health and Safety Specialist will focus on risk mitigation, injury prevention and drive ownership of safety, health and environmental impacts enhancing the safety culture. The individual will develop, implement, and continuously improve programs within the EHS Management System framework in partnership with the broader Global teams. The successful candidate will also ensure compliance with applicable BOEING Policies & Procedures, federal, state, and local environmental, health, and safety regulations, and conformance to industry and consensus standards, as appropriate.Position Responsibilities:- Support projects aimed at anticipating, recognizing, evaluating and controlling safety and environmental hazards.- Ensure the EHS Management System elements are applied effectively throughout the Business.- Drive thorough investigations for all incidents and accidents, develop effective root cause analysis and countermeasures, and ensure timely completion of corrective actions.- Help developing and guiding management to improve their effectiveness as safety leaders.- Effectively communicate company metrics and Key Performance Indicators to functional teams and leadership.- Support conducting site audits, inspections, evaluations, and reviews as necessary.- Support deliberate improvement efforts to improve overall EHS program performance.- Evaluate existing or emergent risk management control technologies and provide information, regulatory assessment, and interpretation and required reporting, and technical expertise to management and employees.- Analyze and assess plant safety trend data and KPI to drive safety resource allocation and drive ergonomic initiatives to reduce injuries.- Supervises the Operating Permit for the local chemical warehouse site in Henstedt-UlzburgBasic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):- Successful completion of an EHS apprenticeship within the logistics and/or wholesale sector.- 4+ years’ experience working in a position with responsibility for safety and environmental programs preferably in warehouse logistics, manufacturing or similar industrial segment.- Fluent German and English skills.- Experience working with SAP based ERP systems.Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):- Bachelor’s degree in occupational safety, environmental science or related disciplines or equivalent subject matter knowledge skills and abilities acquired through work.- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) and ENABLON.- Experience developing and implementing safety and environmental programs, policies, and training.- Experience in the fields of Federal Immission Control Act, Major Accident Ordinance- Ability to be self-directed and complete work with minimal day-to-day supervision.Conflict of Interest:Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.Benefits:- Annual salary reviews- 30 days of paid vacation, which increase with length of service- Social benefits such as capital-forming benefits, a childcare allowance, and a contribution to the company pension plan- Boeing offers continuing education to help participants gain a deeper understanding in various fields of EHS.- Cross-functional and international work in teams around the globe- Tailored training opportunities for your area of work- Regular working hours and flex time- An in-house cafeteria with subsidized meals- A subsidy for the HVV ProfiTicket- Free-to-use e-charging stations- Bicycle leasing (JobRad) with attractive conditions- A subsidized membership in the EGYM Wellpass programWork Authorization:This requisition is for a locally hired position in Germany. Candidates must have current legal authorization to work immediately in Germany.Boeing will not attempt to obtain Immigration and labor sponsorship for any applicantsErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement (BGM)Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Erstellung von Brandschutzplänen, SAP S/4HANA, Gefahren-Management-Systeme - GMS, Arbeitsplatzanalyse, Unterricht, Schulung (außerschulischer Bereich), Brandschutz, Technische RisikoanalysenExpertenkenntnisse: Arbeitsschutz, Unfallverhütung, Arbeitsschutz- und -sicherheitsaudit

corrective actions- Coordinate and facilitate the resolution of production-related quality issues- Lead the handling of customer concerns and complaints, including root cause analysis and implementation of preventive measures- Act as a trusted advisor to production teams on all quality-related matters- Support cross-functional projects within the designated value stream organization- processes- Lead and coordinate continuous improvement initiatives- Implement and maintain company-specific quality processes and standards- Support the Quality Manager in the regular evaluation and Apply today!

Joining Collins Aerospace isn’t just about finding a job; it’s about embarking on a journey to redefine the future of aerospace technology. Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defence industry. Collins Aerospace has the capabilities, comprehensive portfolio, and expertise to solve customers’ toughest challenges and to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving global market.  This an opportunity for an Indirect Buyer to join the ever-successful Lubeck Collins site. You will ensure continuous flow of indirect Goods and Services in support of manufacturing, facilities, engineering, and all other functional areas of the business for Military and Civil requirements.Join Our Team!What you will do - To adapt and improve your agility in an ever-changing landscape- Industry specific knowledge- To excel in a highly innovative environmentExperience & Skills - Proven experience working in a Tactical Buyer position- Demonstratable experience and understanding in an Indirect Buying role- Must have strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple projects simultaneously- Adhere to all UTC rules and codes of conduct- Ensure Compliance with all Corporate Polices- Understanding of PO Contract Packages per Compliance standards- Experience working with MRP system- Excellent communication skills and the willingness to collaborate with internal and external teams- Fluent in German and English (C1 or above) is essential- Please note this is a 2 year fixed term contractCertifications - Bachelor's and Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, English, Accounting, Business/Administration, Engineering, Education, Communication, Management or equivalent experienceWhat we Offer you - An international company with a lot of expertise in aviation- Global talent management program- A unique and dedicated team- Flexible working hours- Individual training opportunities- Attractive salary- Great team events- Company health care- Company pension plan- Job bike- Company sports program- Canteen with fresh kitchen

jobs.occupation: Barkhausen Institut gGmbH: Senior Engineer “Digital Hardware-Design” (m/w/d) (Embedded-Systems-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description: The Barkhausen Institut performs research on the latest hardware, software and communication technologies and demonstrates their application in tomorrow’s society. Our goal is to build a flexible and trustworthy IoT platform based on reliable electronics and secure communication methods.The group Scalable Computing Hardware is developing a secure and dependable multiprocessor system-on-chip (MPSoC) to establish a hardware platform for applications in the area of connected electronic systems.At the earliest possible date we are looking for aSenior Engineer “Digital Hardware Design” (m/w/d)The position will initially be filled for a period of 2 years and will be remunerated in line with TV-L E-13.Your responsibilities will include- Designing, developing and integrating digital hardware architectures for ASIC and FPGA designs- Independently defining, planning, and leading hardware architecture concepts- Implementing, simulating, and verifying digital hardware on RTL level using EDA software tools- Supporting FPGA prototyping and ASIC front-end design through to tape-out- Collaborating with backend teams to analyze and optimize RTL designs- Creating design and verification documentation- Setting up and managing Git flows and CI/CD pipelinesWe expect the following- Above-average M.Sc./Diploma degree in the field of electrical engineering/computer science or a comparable qualification- An integrative and cooperative personality with excellent communication and social skills- Very strong programming skills in Verilog/VHDL and Python- At least 5 years of professional experience in ASIC design, including working with modern EDA software tools (Cadence, Synopsys, open-source)- Very good communication and writing skills in English and German- Basic technical knowledge in the areas of processor systems and hardware securityYou are interested, but you don’t think you meet all the requirements of the job posting? Then you should know: We don’t hire resumes, we hire people. We are looking for potential and want to actively foster it. That’s why we encourage you to apply!What we provide- An open and creative team- Agile working hours and workflows- Cross-disciplinary projects- Work on future technologies- Flat hierarchies for your ideas and flexible teams- Our remuneration is based on the collective agreement for the federal states. If you meet all the professional requirements (diploma/master’s degree or doctorate), this position is classified as TV-L E 13. Depending on your professional experience, the basic monthly salary ranges between €4.759,37 and €6.764,69. We will be happy to provide more details during the interview.If you have passion for new technologies and the desire to develop the connected world of tomorrow with us, we are looking for you.Life and science are compatible at our institute. We offer a range of recognised family-friendly measures, such as part-time work, mobile working and flexible working hours that take family needs into account. We also offer support for arriving in Dresden (all formalities, apartment etc.).Application Procedure- Your application should include: CV, copy of university degree certificate- Barkhausen Institut strives for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability.- We only accept complete documents as one single PDF document by e-mail to Kontakt (über Bewerben-Kontaktformular) . Please reference ”Senior Engineer - Digital Hardware-Design” in the subject line. Applications that contain other file formats (e.g. Word, Excel) will not be considered in the selection process. Informal inquiries can also be submitted to the same address.The data submitted by you in the course of the application procedure will be processed by the Barkhausen Institut (BI). BI shall use the data for the purposes of the application procedure. No data shall be passed on to third parties.Schlagworte: BI, IoT, Internet of Things, designer, digital hardware architectures, eda-softwaretools, rtl-designs, frontend, Barkhausen Institut, python, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308199/senior-engineer-digital-hardware-design-m-strich-w-strich-d (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308199/senior-engineer-digital-hardware-design-m-strich-w-strich-d#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenDas Barkhausen Institut ist ein international anerkanntes Forschungsinstitut, das die Brücke zwischen Grundlagenforschung und der praktischen Umsetzung der Vertrauenswürdigkeit vernetzter elektronischer Systeme schlägt.Wir erforschen innovative Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologien, um die Vertrauenswürdigkeit für eine vernetzte Welt zu ermöglichen. Unser Fokus liegt auf Eigenschaften wie Integrität, Zurechenbarkeit, Authentizität, Verfügbarkeit und Datenschutz.Neben unserer anwendungsorientierten Grundlagenforschung engagieren wir uns als Kooperationspartner und als Meinungsführer im Diskurs zum Thema Vertrauenswürdigkeit. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine professionelle Wissenschaftskommunikation und suchen den Dialog mit der Öffentlichkeit.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
